name: FlowPath
description: FlowJo-style single-cell analysis for multiplexed tissue imaging in QuPath.

extensions.name: FlowPath
extensions.description: Interactive tree-based cell phenotyping with hierarchical gates: threshold, quadrant and 2D region gates over per-compartment marker measurements, with live preview in the viewer and phenotype CSV export. Designed for multiplexed imaging data (CODEX, MIBI, mIF).
extensions.author: sceriff0
